captureShape.rule: Every planned variant is a distinct physical performance. Gain-only or pitch-only copies do not satisfy a take slot.

technicalAcceptance.durationRule: target-length mismatch is warning only; semantic/material performance is a later human gate

provenance.privacyRule: Use a location class such as home-room, workshop or outdoor-private; do not put a street address in repo-bound evidence.

humanGates: different variants are genuinely different physical performances
clean beginning/tail or documented intentional tail
cue intent remains readable under weather bed
source selection and any later edits receive listening QA
rules: Preparation creates filename slots and operator guidance only; it never claims a recording exists.
Technical intake validates container/PCM identity, hashes, clipping/full-scale samples, filenames and provenance completeness only.
Technical pass is not material-fit, variation-value, listening, source-approved, derived-master-approved, Unity-integrated, Quest-approved or release-approved evidence.
Raw accepted takes are immutable source originals. Any edit creates a new file identity and enters the derived-master/listening pipeline.
SFX_FIRESTEEL_STRIKE_001 and fire-start-specific Foley remain outside this session because issue #8 is owner-gated.
